text_block_list.text: After watching a movie to take a breather……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um...
You're a trainer from the Academy, right?
Are you here for this movie too...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?! If it's alright with you,
would you mind sharing your impressions?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for blurting that out so suddenly. To tell the truth,
this movie is adapted from one of my favorite novels...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: As a fan of the original work, I was just so happy to see it adapted to the screen...!
choice_data_list: That final car chase was amazing!
The visuals were beautiful, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Indeed, that scene had me sweating bullets too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So speed and visual impact really are vital
when it comes to movies, huh...
choice_data_list: It really gets you hyped, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I see, that's very helpful...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
By the way, in the original work, during that scene,
the protagonist and heroine confess their feelings
while escaping on foot, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Switching it to a car chase definitely heightened the realism.
Your driving technique was incredible too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still, perhaps I should have been more attentive to the subtleties of their emotions. It might have been better to get out of the car halfway and walk instead. And besides—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I-I'm so sorry for rambling on and on...!
I just got all fired up on my own...!
Zenno Rob Roy's review of the movie was also brimming with brisk pacing and vibrant enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I totally understand...! The visuals were so stunning, they brought the world and atmosphere of the original work right to life.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the music matching the video was lovely,
so I felt completely refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I feel like I can give it my all in practice starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I work hard in training, I'll build up strength,
and I know I can get good results in my races...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If I keep winning races, my story will become a true epic...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If that happens, someone might write a book about me, and down the road it could even become a movie—
choice_data_list: If they make it into a movie, I'll definitely go see it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —! C-Could it be... did I just...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hau-! P-Please forget you heard thaaat!
